text:
nina: Heads up 11:30 PT deploy tomorrow for SDK v5.0.0 docs refresh. We're standardizing structured output keys and tightening the JSON schema used in examples. Small breaking change 1: rename `structured_output_v1` -> `structured_response` and require `schema_version` field in responses.

alan: Can you explain what will break for customers?

nina: Most apps unaffected if they use the SDK parsing helpers. Breakage occurs when teams parse raw model output strings assuming the old key. New SDK helpers will accept both keys for 45 days and then remove the old alias. Hosted API will accept both for 45 days, then require `structured_response`.

carla: Will the SDK provide validator helpers for the new `schema_version` field? We need that for QA.

nina: Yes 1 the SDK will add `validate_structured_response()` in Python/JS/Go with a small error class `StructuredSchemaError` and human-friendly messages. Docs include a QA recipe showing unit tests.

sam: Any linter or docs automation changes? Our snippet checker might flag old examples.

nina: We added docs-linter rule STRUCTURED_KEY_DEPRECATION (docs-430). It's WARN for 30 days then ERROR. The docs PR includes an automatic snippet fixer that will rewrite example outputs and add `schema_version: "2026-03-01"`.

docs-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 "docs: structured_response schema and examples" 0 changed files. Linter rule: docs-430. Includes `scripts/fix-structured-examples.py`.

alan: How long will the SDK alias live? We need a concrete timeline for partners.

nina: Alias shim in SDK: 45 days. After that SDK raises `ConfigError` when `structured_output_v1` found in example configs. We will provide a 12-month compatibility mode behind an env var `RWI_ALLOW_LEGACY_STRUCTURED=1` for Dedicated/Private deployments that need more time.

carla: Will Console show a banner for docs authors?

nina: Yes 1 Console banner targeted at docs and SDK repos: "Structured output key changed: migrate to `structured_response`. Use rwi-cli to auto-fix examples." Banner links to migration recipe.

sam: Is there an rwi-cli helper?

nina: `rwi-cli fix-structured-output --check|--fix|--dry-run` in `rwi-cli@1.0.0`. Also `rwi-cli validate-snippets` will run the new validator locally.

release-bot: Draft release note: "SDK v5.0.0 1 structured output key rename (45d alias), schema_version required in examples, linter docs-430, rwi-cli helpers, 12mo env escape for private deployments." Internal checklist: https://internal.redwood/releases/checklists/sdk-5-structured-output

docs-bot: Included migration recipe: code snippets for Python/JS/Go and a sample unit test for the validator.

alan: Any telemetry or privacy implications? The new schema_version is just metadata; no payload changes.

nina: Correct 1 no telemetry changes.

carla: I'll sweep the cookbook tonight and run `--check` in dry-run.

nina: Thanks 1 please review PR before EOD. We'll email #all at 10:00 PT with the timeline and link to the checklist.
